requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat distributor repair-vendor and waste-contractor transfers as explicit custody handoffs with evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Each third-party transfer is recorded as a custody event with holder location and evidence.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: support controlled quantity-batch reconciliation when serial-level identity does not exist while preserving scope limits
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Quantity-batch evidence is allowed without inventing serial-level traceability and its limits remain explicit.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: require destruction evidence to identify the actual quantity or batch scope and leave unreconciled balances open
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Destruction evidence only closes the identified scope and residual balances remain open.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat third-party possession as outside the field-action chain of custody
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Third-party custody remains within the controlled execution ledger.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent serial-level traceability where only quantity-batch evidence exists
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill preserves actual identity granularity rather than fabricating serial data.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: close the full batch from a destruction certificate that covers only part of the quantity
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Partial destruction evidence cannot close unreconciled quantities.
